attempts.sql: SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN code.symbols c ON s.qualname LIKE c.name || '.%' AND s.file_id = c.file_id WHERE s.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND s.kind = 'method' AND c.kind = 'class' AND c.name = 'Client' AND c.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND (s.summary_source = 'none' OR s.summary IS NULL OR s.summary = '') ORDER BY s.line_start
